avis.titre: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Clarifying Solution Acne Toner
avis.texte: I love this medicated toner from La Roche-Posay. I've been using it in my morning skincare routine for a little over a month and have noticed a difference.

So if u want minimal pimples and affordable then buy this. If u want completely clear skin then find something else
